article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Arlandus Keyes scored 17 points as Mount St. Mary's beat Canisius 73-66 on Sunday. Keyes shot 5 for 10 (5 for 9 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Mountaineers (15-10, 8-6 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Jedy Cordilia scored 14 points while finishing 7 of 9 from the floor and added seven rebounds. Dallas Hobbs had 10 points. Paul McMillan IV led the Golden Griffins (2-23, 2-12) in scoring, finishing with 21 points, four assists and two steals. Tana Kopa added 19 points and four steals. The loss is the seventh in a row for the Golden Griffin ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
